title: 卡尔玛·莲花茶席
description: 卡尔玛戴额心宝石与双龙肩饰，穿完整紫绿长袍，在低桌前摆一朵小莲花。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Karma is an adult Ionian woman with warm brown skin, short dark hair, a bright green forehead jewel, and a distinctive curved twin-dragon ornament behind her shoulders. Preserve her serene face and green-purple ceremonial palette through a fully covering layered robe with opaque sleeves and legs. Her magical accents are soft decorative light only, with no combat stance or energy blast.
art_direction.scene: She sits comfortably beside a low round tea table and places a single lotus blossom into a shallow bowl of water. A small cup and folded cloth form a balanced arrangement beside it. One broad leaf and a pale window frame suggest a peaceful courtyard, with her hands and shoulder ornaments clearly separated.
art_direction.palette: jade green, plum purple, lotus pink, cream
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
